chapter: Band family, war years and wrap-up
title: Family at Birmingham concerts and the buck dance
summary: His relatives took up the hall and he did his comic buck dance.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: When I'd go to Birmingham, my mother was living, with the band. I'd go in the auditorium. We'd play the auditorium there. A big concert, we'd have two and three thousand people. But, by the time my family would get in there at the door. You know, like you could get tickets for your family. They'd say Hawkin's family. Maybe, [Laughter] about 20 people (inaudible). Cousins, aunts and everything. They used to say Hawk, you keep looking? My mother's standing on the side

saying yeah.
I'll never forget what they'd say.
When I went home, when Hawkins plays, he's
really gonna have a crowd. The rest of his
family, his family will take up this place.
I had a lot of fun, especially
since we were talking, I had to think about
those days back then. Oh, man. [Chuckles]
You should have seen me do my
buck dance. It was a classic. I was no dancer.
You know. But, I'd just go through the action.
You know, I had my style. And so, I used to
tell the people all kinds of jokes. I'd jump
out there when I started doing my dance like
I'd tell the next show. I'd say well, when I
danced the last show, a lady had a baby in her
arms. When she jumped up to holler, she forgot
she had the baby in her arms. The baby fell in
the aisle. All them kind of sad jokes.
That's the show before. I'm
saying I'm gonna really kill you this show.
And then, we'd call for "Sweet Georgia Brown".
Waited for Paul Bascomb to do his tenor solo. And then the time, what would I do, about a minute, you know. Just long enough to do 3 or 4 steps, and some kid said Hawk. That's all?
Yeah. I had to have fun, you know, when I do those things. It would make the evening go fast and good.
And make a lot of people feel good.
